title: Establishment of Regional Benches of State Commission

content.scenario: The State Government of Tamil Nadu wants to establish regional benches of the State Commission at places other than the State capital.
content.outcome: The State Government of Tamil Nadu may establish regional benches of the State Commission at such places as it deems fit, by notification, in consultation with the State Commission.

user_queries: Can a State Government establish regional benches of the State Commission?
What is the process for establishing regional benches?
Is consultation with the State Commission required?
